sources: Hand-built from the standard lists of OT quotations in the NT, following the NA27/UBS appendix convention (loci citati vel allegati): every recognized direct quotation, including repeated citations of one source and composite citations with several sources. Allusions are omitted except a small set of extremely well-established ones, marked kind=allusion. The formula field marks the two cleanly derivable introductory formulas: 'written' (it is written) and 'fulfilled' (that it might be fulfilled); other introductions leave it off. The note field carries source criticism the lists flag (an attribution mismatch, LXX wording, an adapted citation).
